entries.name: cherry blossom tree
entries.detail: Round pink blossom canopy, cream-yellow flower centers, warm brown trunk, same canopy style as reference pink tree.

entries.name: tulip flower bed
entries.detail: Compact rectangular warm wooden edging, green leaves, coral pink and yellow tulip cups; low planted bed.

entries.name: flower arch
entries.detail: Wooden garden arch with green climbing leaves and pink/cream flowers, clear open passage below, no panel.

entries.name: picnic mat with basket
entries.detail: Red/cream checkered mat foreshortened on ground, small closed wicker basket, no people.

entries.name: kite on a short string stand
entries.detail: Bright small diamond kite on a SHORT taut string anchored to a compact wooden stand; kite and base fit same cell.

entries.name: pink paper lantern on a post
entries.detail: Ribbed round pink paper lantern on warm wooden post with little hanging tassel and simple base.

entries.name: tiered flower pot stand
entries.detail: Three-tier small wooden display with terracotta pots and pink/yellow spring flowers.

entries.name: wooden birdhouse on a pole
entries.detail: Tiny warm wood house with brown roof, round black entrance, short perch, standing pole and base.

entries.name: watering can with flowers
entries.detail: Muted blue-green watering can with handle and long spout, small spring flowers coming out of can.

entries.name: carp streamer pole
entries.detail: Wooden pole with two small carp-shaped windsocks in plain blue and red flat colors; readable fish shapes, no writing.

entries.name: wooden swing
entries.detail: Warm brown A-frame wood swing, two ropes and one hanging plank seat, empty.

entries.name: bush with butterflies
entries.detail: Rounded low green bush, a few small pink blossoms, two tiny yellow/pink butterflies nearby within same cell.

entries.name: striped beach parasol
entries.detail: Red/cream striped domed beach parasol on simple central pole and small round foot; no table.

entries.name: small inflatable pool
entries.detail: Low oval cyan/pale blue inflatable ring pool, blue water with two flat white ripple strokes, no swimmers.

entries.name: sandcastle
entries.detail: Cute compact tan sandcastle with two turret towers, central arch doorway, blocky crenellations.

entries.name: watermelon stand
entries.detail: Small warm wood stand with green/red striped canopy, whole striped watermelons and cut red slices on counter, blank sign.

entries.name: wind chime on a post
entries.detail: Slim wooden post with short hanging arm supporting small glass-blue bell and pale blank dangling paper strip.

entries.name: hibiscus bush
entries.detail: Low rich green bush with several large coral-red hibiscus flowers, pale yellow centers.

entries.name: beach lounge chair
entries.detail: Angled wooden folding lounge chair with blue/cream striped fabric, clearly reclined, seen from above.

entries.name: surfboard standing in sand
entries.detail: Upright turquoise surfboard with a bold cream stripe, planted slightly leaning in a small sand mound, no writing.

entries.name: lawn sprinkler with water spray
entries.detail: Small green sprinkler with two curved cyan streams made of separated solid pixel droplets, no glow or mist.

entries.name: ice cream cart
entries.detail: Small warm cream/wood cart with two wheels, coral/cream umbrella canopy, ice cream tubs and cone-shaped pictogram only, no text.

entries.name: life ring on a post
entries.detail: Cream life ring with four coral-red segments on warm wooden upright, rope loop, compact base.

entries.name: palm tree
entries.detail: Curving brown segmented trunk, spreading chunky bright green fronds, two coconuts, compact ground base.

entries.name: red maple tree
entries.detail: Round layered red/orange maple canopy, distinct leaf clusters, warm brown trunk.

entries.name: yellow ginkgo tree
entries.detail: Round golden-yellow canopy with fan-shaped ginkgo leaf clusters, brown trunk, same scale as maple.

entries.name: scarecrow
entries.detail: Friendly straw-headed scarecrow on wooden cross post, straw hat, orange shirt, blue/olive trousers, no scary face.

entries.name: pile of pumpkins
entries.detail: Three orange pumpkins of different sizes, ribbed shapes and green stems, no carved faces.

entries.name: hay bales
entries.detail: Two golden straw bales, one rectangular and one round, tied with dark brown bands.

entries.name: persimmon tree with orange fruit
entries.detail: Green/olive round canopy, several orange persimmons with green leaf caps, brown trunk.

entries.name: harvest basket with vegetables
entries.detail: Wicker basket filled with orange carrots, green cabbage and yellow squash, clear cozy harvest silhouette.

entries.name: carved pumpkin lantern
entries.detail: Single orange jack-o-lantern with friendly triangular eyes and smiling mouth, bright yellow flat interior, NO glow haze.

entries.name: pile of fallen leaves
entries.detail: Low heap of large orange, ochre and red maple leaves, no tree or container.

entries.name: wooden wheelbarrow with leaves
entries.detail: Warm brown wheelbarrow with one dark wheel and two handles, overflowing red/orange leaves.

entries.name: cosmos flower patch
entries.detail: Small patch of pink, cream and coral cosmos flowers, slender green leaves, compact soil base.

entries.name: full moon paper lantern on a post
entries.detail: Round pale-gold paper lantern like a full moon, visible rib lines, hangs from short wooden post, no printed face or writing.

entries.name: snowman
entries.detail: Two round snowballs, small black eyes, orange carrot nose, red scarf, simple brown hat and stick arms.

entries.name: decorated christmas tree
entries.detail: Green triangular pine, gold star topper, small red/gold ornaments, light snow touches, no gift pile.

entries.name: snow-covered pine tree
entries.detail: Plain layered pine with thick white snowy branch tops, dark green lower branches, brown trunk.

entries.name: small igloo
entries.detail: Small rounded white/ice blue block igloo, low curved dark doorway, no interior furniture.

entries.name: wooden sled
entries.detail: Warm wood slatted sled, two curved runners, short rope, resting on ground.

entries.name: ice sculpture of a swan
entries.detail: Recognizable pale blue crystalline swan, graceful S-shaped neck, folded ice wings, small solid ice pedestal, flat facets no transparency.

entries.name: pile of wrapped presents
entries.detail: Three boxes in red, green and gold with cream bows, stacked neatly, blank wrapping.

entries.name: giant candy cane
entries.detail: One tall hooked red/cream striped candy cane planted in a tiny white snow base.

entries.name: pile of snowballs
entries.detail: Low pyramid of five or six white snowballs with flat pale-blue undersides, no characters.

entries.name: campfire with logs
entries.detail: Small orange/gold flame above crossed warm brown logs, flat bright shapes, no bloom or smoke haze.

entries.name: arch of string lights
entries.detail: Simple dark wooden arch with a looping string of red/gold/blue light dots, open passage, no solid panel, no glow.

entries.name: hot cocoa stand
entries.detail: Cozy small wooden stall with red/cream striped awning and snow cap, cocoa pot and steaming mugs on counter, blank sign with optional mug pictogram only.
